content: Sthira sukham asanam. (The meditative posture should be steady, stable, and comfortable).
author: Patanjali
explanation: True posture—both physical and mental—embodies an optimal equilibrium between unyielding firmness and effortless relaxation.
practicalInsight: Check your body posture and mental attitude right now. Release unnecessary tension in your shoulders while maintaining upright, dignified presence.
reflectionPrompt: Where in my life can I combine firm purpose with effortless ease?
